text:
# 分析了 500 万条 ChatGPT 提示词：哪些发现对 GEO 真正重要

- 作者：Nicholas Dulait（@NicholasDulait）
- 发布时间：2026-08-28 17:14（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/nicholasdulait/status/2093265964552856015
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29
- 说明：中文全文与英文原文；数据和结论按作者原文保留，未独立验证。

## 中文全文

来自 Link Garden 的 Jacky，和 Paul（我的联合创始人）、Antoine 一起参加了 MVP 播客。

他每个月在 ChatGPT 上抓取 100 万条提示词的结果。连续 5 个月，每个月使用同样的提示词。总共 500 万个答案，提取每一个品牌，记录每一个来源。

大多数 GEO 建议只是观点。这是我见过最接近数据依据的东西。

在深入讨论之前，如果你想知道我们现在如何做 SEO/GEO：

[你可以免费试用 ChatSEO](https://link.chatseo.app/EWdoT9O)

（无需信用卡，10 秒完成设置。）

*使用我们自己的产品取得的 SEO/GEO 结果。*

以下是我的收获：

## 1. Reddit 这套玩法正在失效

2025 年末：Reddit 出现在大约 80% 的 ChatGPT 答案中。4 个月前，在法国的引用率是 30%。7 月降到 9%，8 月约为 5%，而且仍在下降。

在某些垂直领域，它从来就没有奏效。比如汽车保险：Reddit 的占比为 3%，5 个月里没有变化。

规律很简单：任何来源一旦变得过于有效，就会被 SEO 从业者用垃圾内容淹没，随后模型会降低它的权重。如果你的 GEO 策略是“去 Reddit 发帖”，那你优化的还是 2025 年 12 月的情况。

## 2. 反向链接不能预测引用

从他的数据看：一个只有 5 个引荐域名的网站，被引用了 200 次。旁边另一个有 200 个引荐域名的网站，却一次也没被引用。

ChatSEO 中有一个智能体，可以免费帮你获得这些反向链接。我们称之为“Ninja linking”。

只需把这段提示词复制粘贴进 ChatSEO：

> 我需要你帮我寻找可以免费放置反向链接的位置。

原提示词：

```text
Need you to find free backlinks placement for me
```

域名权威性是 Google 的信号。大语言模型并不以同样的方式看待它。小型垂直网站不断被选入，不是因为它们大，而是因为它们精准。

## 3. 情感追踪被高估了

他给数百万个命名实体打分，范围从 -9 到 +9。平均值约为 2。“好”的分数是 3 或 4，“差”的分数是 -1。

这些模型在设计上倾向于迎合共识，几乎没有什么会得到负面评价。在他的数据中，Conor McGregor 的分数比 Hitler 还低，这说明这套尺度有多奇怪。

别为了情感分数买工具。要买，就为了引用追踪买。

## 4. 2,000 欧元的引用和 20 欧元的引用，起的作用一样

引用会轮换。一个来源 3 月出现，4 月消失，6 月又回来。同一个提示词下，大约有 50 个来源轮换，任意一次答案中会出现 10—15 个。

这意味着，在大型媒体网站上花 1,500 欧元获得的一次提及，会持续 1—3 个月；在一个相关小网站上花 20 欧元获得的提及，也是如此。大型媒体的溢价，大部分只是在为一个标志付钱。

## 5. 为什么引用比你想的更重要：18 个月的空档

答案有两种：带来源的，说明模型搜索了网络；不带来源的，说明模型依据训练数据回答。

如果你在 2026 年 1 月推出一个品牌，它就不在任何训练集中。进入训练集需要 1—2 年，平均 18 个月。在此之前，只有当模型决定搜索时，你才存在。有些月份，90% 的查询会搜索；有些月份则是 30%。

今天的引用，是你进入 2027 年数据集的方式。这才是真正的投资回报，而不是本月的某个答案。

## 6. 没有人是在为提示词取得排名，你争取的是扇出查询的排名

这一点改变了我对 GEO 关键词的看法。

当有人输入一段很长的提示词，比如“我练了柔道，伤了背，去看过医生，还是睡不着，怎么办”，模型并不会搜索这整段话。它会把提示词改写成 2—5 个简短子查询。这里可能是：“best mattress back pain”（背痛最适合的床垫）。

柔道不重要，医生也不重要。30 个不同的人写下 30 个不同的提示词，模型会把它们归并成同样的 3 个搜索。

所以，“每个提示词都独一无二，因此无法为 GEO 做关键词研究”这个说法是错的。提示词各不相同，但扇出查询并非如此。

过去大约一年里，扇出查询的形态是：“best + [topic] + 2026 + [country]”，即“最佳 + [主题] + 2026 + [国家]”，同时以用户的语言和英语生成。

把这段提示词复制粘贴到 ChatSEO，就能寻找你的 GEO 查询：

> 找出与我的业务有关的所有 GEO 查询，并告诉我今天应该优先针对哪些查询。

原提示词：

```text
Find all the GEO queries for my business and tell me which ones I should target today
```

## 我会如何运用这些发现

停止追踪提示词，开始追踪扇出查询。你的 GEO 关键词清单，就是模型实际执行的那组简短查询，而这份清单与传统 SEO 的距离，比人们愿意承认的近得多。

这正是我们在 ChatSEO 中开发 GEO 智能体的目的：分析你的网站，找出模型在你的主题下会执行哪些扇出查询，再给你一份应当争取排名的清单。因为到最后，模型还是会打开 Google。

做好 SEO，在相关的小网站上获得引用，并且每月重新检查扇出查询。这就是当下这场竞争的全部。

## 英文原文

# 5M ChatGPT prompts analyzed. Here's what matters for GEO:

Jacky from Link Garden came on the MVP podcast with Paul (my co-founder) and Antoine.

He scrapes 1 million prompts on ChatGPT every month. Same prompts, every month, for 5 months. 5 million answers, every brand extracted, every source logged.

Most GEO advice is opinion. This is the closest thing to data I've seen.

Oh and before we dive in, If you're wondering how we're doing our SEO/GEO today: 

[You can try ChatSEO for free](https://link.chatseo.app/EWdoT9O)
(no credit card - set up in 10 seconds)

![原图](<../../90_附件/配图/2093265964552856015-1.png>)Using our own product - SEO/GEO results

Here's what I took from it:

## 1. The Reddit play is dying

Late 2025: Reddit was in roughly 80% of ChatGPT answers. 4 months ago (France): 30% citation rate. July: 9%. August: around 5% and still dropping.

In some verticals it never worked. Car insurance: Reddit sits at 3% and hasn't moved in 5 months.

The pattern is simple. Any source that gets too effective gets spammed by SEOs, and the model dials it down. If your GEO strategy is "post on Reddit", you're optimizing for December 2025.

## 2. Backlinks don't predict citations

From his data: a site with 5 referring domains cited 200 times. Next to it, a site with 200 referring domains cited zero times.

We have an agent at ChatSEO that can get you these backlinks for free, it's what we call "Ninja linking".

Just copy-paste this prompt in [ChatSEO](https://link.chatseo.app/EWdoT9O): 

"Need you to find free backlinks placement for me" 

Domain authority is a Google signal. The LLMs don't look at it the same way. Small niche sites get pulled in constantly because they're precise, not because they're big.

## 3. Sentiment tracking is overrated

He scores millions of named entities from -9 to +9. The average is around 2. A "good" score is 3 or 4. A "bad" score is -1.

The models are consensual by design. Almost nothing is negative. Conor McGregor scores lower than Hitler in his data, which tells you how weird the scale is.

Don't buy a tool for the sentiment score. Buy it for the citation tracking.

## 4. The €2,000 citation and the €20 citation do the same thing

Citations rotate. A source shows up in March, disappears in April, comes back in June. Around 50 sources rotate on the same prompt, 10 to 15 appear on any given answer.

That means a €1,500 mention on a big media site lasts 1 to 3 months, same as a €20 mention on a small relevant site. The big media premium is mostly paying for a logo.

## 5. Why citations matter more than you think: the 18 month gap

Two kinds of answers. With sources (the model searched the web) and without sources (the model answered from training data).

If you launched a brand in January 2026, you are not in any training set. It takes 1 to 2 years to get in, 18 months on average. Until then, you only exist when the model decides to search. Some months that's 90% of queries. Some months it's 30%.

Citations today are how you enter the dataset of 2027. That's the real ROI, not this month's answer.

## 6. Nobody ranks for the prompt. You rank for the fan-out.

This is the one that changed how I think about GEO keywords.

When someone writes a long prompt ("I did judo, hurt my back, saw a doctor, still can't sleep, what do I do"), the model doesn't search for that. It rewrites the prompt into 2 to 5 short sub-queries. Here: "best mattress back pain".

Judo doesn't matter. The doctor doesn't matter. 30 different people write 30 different prompts and the model collapses them all into the same 3 searches.

So "we can't do keyword research for GEO because every prompt is unique" is wrong. The prompts are unique. The fan-outs are not.

What the fan-outs looked like for about a year: "best + [topic] + 2026 + [country]", generated in the user's language and in English.

Copy-paste this prompt ([in ChatSEO](https://link.chatseo.app/EWdoT9O)) to find your GEO queries:

"Find all the GEO queries for my business and tell me which ones I should target today"

## What I'd do with this

Stop tracking prompts. Start tracking fan-outs. Your GEO keyword list is the set of short queries the model actually runs, and that list is a lot closer to classic SEO than people want to admit.

That's exactly what we built the GEO agent in ChatSEO to do: take your site, work out which fan-out queries the models run in your topic, and give you the list to go rank for. Because in the end the model still opens Google.

Do your SEO well, get cited on small relevant sites, and re-check the fan-outs monthly. That's the whole game right now.
